name: Bakunyuu! Dekajiri! Ama Oba-san
original_name: 爆乳!デカ尻!海女叔母さん
source:
Shinichi Hayasaka paid a visit to his aunt Mariko's home, where he had lived as a child.
She was like a mother to him. However, she had become a diver in the years he was away, and he saw her now in all her womanliness: mature, alluring, incredibly sexual. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE089001]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
早坂新一回到了他小时候住过的姨妈真理子的家中。对他来说，她就像母亲一样。然而在他离开的这些年里，她成为了一名海女。如今他看到的她，充满了成熟女性的魅力：成熟、迷人、性感至极。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE089001]DLsite English[/url]]
